s.t: Rolling Stone's 1974 review of the album called ‘Must of Got Lost’ “really the only lapse on the entire album”; released as a single, it reached No. 12.
s.src: Tom Dunson, Rolling Stone, 21 November 1974 (review of Nightmares…and Other Tales from the Vinyl Jungle, as reproduced by Super Seventies)
s.q: But "Must of Got Lost" is really the only lapse on the entire album.

s.t: When the band's 1979 Best Of cut ‘Must of Got Lost’ to 2:53, Robert Christgau quipped that it was “as well-named as ever”.
s.src: Robert Christgau: Consumer Guide, The J. Geils Band
s.q: Between the three cuts from Bloodshot , where they announced their arena-rock proclivities, and the two from Blow Your Face Out , where they reified them, "Musta Got Lost" is as well-named as ever.

s.t: The J. Geils Band's ‘Must of Got Lost’ plays in Disney's 2004 film Miracle, about the 1980 US Olympic hockey team, and over the closing credits of Eastbound & Down.
s.q: This song is featured in the 2004 Disney movie Miracle and in the end-credits of the series finale of Eastbound & Down.

f.t: Peter Wolf studied painting at Boston's Museum School before fronting the band; his first roommate there was the future film director David Lynch.
f.src: Rolling Stone: Peter Wolf Literally Knew Everybody
f.q: As a young painter from the Bronx, studying at Boston’s Museum of Fine Arts, his freshman roommate is a mild-mannered student named David Lynch.

f.t: As a Boston DJ in the late 1960s, Peter Wolf befriended Van Morrison, then hiding out from the mob; the pair once walked home together from Boston to Cambridge.
f.src: Rolling Stone: Peter Wolf Literally Knew Everybody
f.q: He bonds with Van Morrison in the late Sixties, when the Irish bard is hiding out from the mob. … Once he found out that I was the DJ, and I found out that he was Van Morrison, we walked home all the way to Cambridge from Boston.

f.t: Peter Wolf married the actress Faye Dunaway in August 1974, reportedly a day after they got engaged; she had suggested it on a walk along a beach.
f.src: Ultimate Classic Rock: Peter Wolf and Faye Dunaway
f.q: The couple reportedly tied the knot just one day after getting engaged.

f.t: Guitarist J. Geils raced cars five times a year at the band's early-1980s peak, and later ran KTR Motorsports, restoring vintage Ferraris and Maseratis.
f.q: He drove in five races a year during the early 1980s, at the peak of the J. Geils Band's popularity. He opened KTR Motorsports, an automobile restoration shop in Ayer, Massachusetts to service and repair vintage sports cars such as Ferrari and Maserati.

f.t: Harmonica player Magic Dick, whose ‘Whammer Jammer’ made him a star, recalled his bandmates teasing him that his instrument could be bought at Woolworths.
f.src: NPR: Pocket Full of Soul (harmonica documentary)
f.q: I used to get kidded by the guys in the J. Geils Band that you could buy my instrument at Woolworths.

nf.t: Peter Wolf's first roommate at art school in Boston was David Lynch
nf.src: Rolling Stone: Peter Wolf Literally Knew Everybody
nf.q: his freshman roommate is a mild-mannered student named David Lynch.
